hooks.name: IaC / container file save nudge
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to check infrastructure-as-code or container files for misconfigurations right after they're saved.

action.prompt: An infrastructure/container file was just saved. Load the relevant playbook (iac-misconfig-scan or container-image-scan from .kiro/steering/security/ via disclose_context) and offer to run the matching script (scripts/iac-scan.sh or scripts/container-scan.sh) on the changed file. Keep this brief, one or two sentences, not a full report unless the user asks for one.
